items.title: manual/per-case PDF v1.0.2 versus HTML/catalog v1.0.4
items.evidence: All 21 PDFs identify v1.0.2; all 21 HTML pages identify engine v1.0.4.
items.disposition: Use HTML only for the latest published result, PDF/manual for archival narrative, and independent source for acceptance truth.
items.releaseImpact: Raw STRIX runtime provenance remains blocked.

items.title: HTML engine label conflicts with run/archive v1.0.2 metadata
items.evidence: SB9, SB12, PD1, SP1, SH1 and TH1 show v1.0.4 engine but v1.0.2 run date/archive provenance.
items.disposition: Do not call these cases v1.0.4 reruns until the raw record and archive are published.

items.title: Raw record SHA and evidence archives are unavailable
items.evidence: Every HTML page says sha256=(pending publish); records/*.json and evidence ZIPs are absent.
items.disposition: Retain page hash as publication custody only.

items.title: SB10 tolerance precision conflict
items.disposition: Do not approve a numeric tolerance until owner/raw-record confirmation.

items.title: SH1 individual PDF result table is clipped
items.evidence: Two PCHIP rows are not visible in the PDF; HTML/catalog contains all 11 rows.
items.disposition: Use HTML for published rows and retain PDF only as incomplete archival narrative.
items.releaseImpact: Blocks claims that the PDF alone is a complete record.

items.title: Catalog array order differs from manual order
items.disposition: Official ordinal is frozen to manual order=SB1,SB2,SB3,SB5,SB6,SB7,SB8,SB9,SB10,SB12,PD1,SM5,SM5b,SM6,SR1,SR2,SR2b,P3S2,SP1,SH1,TH1.

items.title: P15-M0 recorded PDF binary is missing and current PDF is a later regeneration
items.disposition: Preserve the current PDF as a P17-observed snapshot only; never relabel it as the P15-M0 binary.
items.releaseImpact: Prevents immutable provenance claim for the original Phase15 PDF.

items.title: Phase15 fixed output paths are writable despite append-only policy
items.evidence: The existing benchmark/report writers use fixed JSON, Markdown and PDF filenames.
items.disposition: P17 snapshots are content-addressed and overwrite-rejecting; legacy writers must not run during M0.
items.releaseImpact: Requires P17-M1 append-only writer before case execution.

items.title: STRIX PDFs provide no redistribution license
items.evidence: PDF marking is Internal / All rights reserved; public download is not redistribution permission.
items.disposition: Keep local custody references and hashes; do not redistribute source PDFs without permission.
items.releaseImpact: No local verification blocker; distribution is restricted.
